question: Dhanush crosses a road 100 metres wide in 50 seconds. His speed in km/hr is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed in m/s = 100 ÷ 50 = 2 m/s

To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5:

Speed in km/h = 2 × (18/5) = 7.2 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 7.2 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance crossed (D) = 100 m

Time taken (T) = 50 s

**Formula Used:**

Speed (S) = Distance (D) ÷ Time (T)

Conversion: 1 m/s = 18/5 km/h
